details: A fully fictional paper exercise: customer X wants 2 units, equipment M, year 2020, interface 20 millimeters, old part P20; do not promise before the interface is confirmed. Catalog v1: A=P20, fits M/2020/20 millimeters, tax-inclusive unit price 120 yuan, 1 in stock, second unit restock day D+2; B=P25, fits M/2020/25 millimeters, tax-inclusive 90 yuan, 2 in stock. The customer requires both units on day D; in this exercise freight is 20 yuan, with no additional tax or discount, and partial shipment terms are unconfirmed. Five questions: which information should be added, which candidate matches, the total price of two A units including freight, whether the lead time is met, and what to do if the customer has already opened the package and wants a return? Answer: confirm the interface first and record 20 millimeters; A matches per the fictional catalog and B does not fit so it is not a substitute; 2×120+20=260 yuan; A has only 1 in stock, so two units on the same day cannot be promised, and D+2 or a partial shipment must be confirmed and agreed by the customer; the exercise gives no return policy or old part fault diagnosis, so the order, packaging, and policy must be checked and escalated, without guaranteeing a refund or installation safety. Fully fictional, not a real fitment.
